boundary: Pinned original fields and assembly metadata -> conditional Subtitle construction -> local callback instruction order; no game assembly execution.

fieldSelection.finding: Lookup returns the first exactly case-sensitive title. AssignedField rejects null/empty values, not whitespace. FieldValue(null) returns null.

For a nonempty Localization.language, currentDialogueText uses the field titled exactly that language when assigned, otherwise Dialogue Text. currentMenuText and currentSequence use Menu Text <language> / Sequence <language> when assigned, otherwise base fields. For empty language use base fields. These selectors do not consult useDefaultIfUndefined.

subtitleText chooses nonempty currentDialogueText, else currentMenuText. This is raw field content before FormattedText.Parse. Among126 original registrations,120 select Dialogue Text and6 select Menu Text; ru parameter has no assigned localized field and produces the same original selections. This is not a runtime language assertion.

construction.finding: GetState(nonnull entry) sends OnPrepareConversationLine(entry), marks displayed, sets Lua thisID/Dialog table, then when skipExecution=false runs userScript and entry.onExecute; after actor/conversant info it also invokes a resolved scene event unless skipExecution. It then parses subtitleText, checks Sequence only for a legacy Video File warning, and constructs Subtitle with currentSequence/currentResponseMenuSequence, same entry reference and entrytag. Entry preparation, scripts and scene callbacks precede selected fields; MarkDialogueEntryDisplayed is not rendering proof.

Both Subtitle constructors store provided CharacterInfo, FormattedText, sequence, responseMenuSequence and original entry reference. If FormattedText has a nonempty variableInputPrompt, CheckVariableInputPrompt appends TextInput(Text Field UI,prompt,prompt), adding semicolon-space only after a nonempty sequence. No default camera sequence is inserted by the constructor.

Only model construction with initialDialogueEntryID=-1 calls FixFirstStateSequence: nonnull state/subtitle with empty sequence and empty formatted text becomes None(). Explicit initial IDs bypass that fix. Controller subsequently changes a first state whose original entry isGroup and sequence equals String.Empty to state.isGroup=false and sequence Continue(); null sequence does not equal empty. The cached arc first node does not establish actual initial state.

Parse first replaces Lua tags, extracts input prompt, replaces variable/autocase tags and pipes, then extracts picture/flags/noSubtitle/position/panel tags and emphasis processing before constructing FormattedText. Exact helper behavior and runtime Lua/settings inputs are not accepted in this phase. Original text is not asserted equal to formattedText.text.

callbackDispatch.finding: Controller.Initialize emits OnConversationStart before attaching FinishedSubtitleHandler and SelectedResponseHandler, sets current conversation ID/override then GotoState(first). GotoState installs state/active record first; on conversation ID change it sends linked-start before updating participant records/portraits/override. Group states show the last NPC subtitle and return; only non-group states call StartSubtitle.

StartSubtitle notifies OnConversationLine before ShouldShowSubtitle and UI.ShowSubtitle, before {{default}} replacement and before sequence execution/preprocessing. It stores _subtitle only on the shown branch. It records lastSubtitle on both branches and invokes the optional spoken delegate before PlaySequence. The raw line-begin sequence can differ from the executed one.

NotifyParticipants(nonnull subtitle) broadcasts to valid speaker transform, valid listener unless same valid transform, then always to DialogueManager.instance, carrying the same Subtitle object. Manager is not de-duplicated against participant transforms/hierarchies. DialogueSystemEvents.OnConversationLine/End invoke their respective UnityEvents. This is local emission order, not actual receiver multiplicity, scene identity or Unity listener execution order.

DialogueService.AddEventListeners uses one FindObjectOfType<DialogueSystemEvents> result without an explicit null guard, subscribing start, linked-start, end, cancelled, line-begin, line-end, response-menu in that order. Remove re-finds an object and checks Unity nonnull. Base Start sets isStarted then registers once when awakened/started, not quitting/destroyed and not already registered; eventsRegistered is written only after the virtual add returns. OnEnable can register after Start; Disable/Destroy remove under base guards. DialogueService.Start calls base before its Initialize. Actual found instance, persistent listeners and relative StoryManager/DialogueService lifecycle order remain unverified.

View.Initialize opens UI/sequencer and hooks sequencer FinishedSequenceHandler to OnFinishedSubtitle -> FinishSubtitle. Finish waits while waitForContinue. Otherwise it stops an existing sequencer, hides lastSubtitle, and if notifyOnFinishSubtitle clears that flag, broadcasts line-end(lastSubtitle) only when stored _subtitle is nonnull, then calls FinishedSubtitleHandler. The plugin field-use scan has one _subtitle store, in the shown StartSubtitle branch, and no clear; first hidden line therefore lacks that gate on a new view, while a later hidden line can retain it. Controller finish then chooses NPC/auto response/menu/close; selection/reachability is not proved.

After the begin broadcast, nonempty sequence containing {{default}} is replaced in the field. Later PreprocessSequence stores shortcut replacement but substitutes {{end}} only in its return value; empty sequence calls GetDefaultSequence as PlaySequence argument without assigning that result to Subtitle.sequence. Default choice depends on PC/NPC, display settings and previous response-menu state, with Delay(duration) fallback in the normal default branch.

The subscribed begin handler runs implicit trigger handling before actor handling. Its synthetic line-end uses actual formattedText.text and entry IDs; phase78 direct builder preplay instead supplies raw subtitleText. Six original BIO target registrations have explicit None() and positive actors; under unchanged fields/sequence and false latch they bypass the actor change test and call line-end, regardless of later visibility checks. Actual preceding latch/context/callback mutations are not accepted.
